visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in an indoor fitness studio with a prominent red neon 'X' sign. A muscular man, Peeta, wearing a black tank top and white baseball cap, holds a large fan of 1000 NTD bills, smiling and addressing the camera. (2) Suddenly, a man in a white tank top snatches the money and runs. Peeta reacts with a shout and begins a frantic pursuit through the gym interior, past gym equipment and tables. (3) The chase moves to an outdoor urban sidewalk. The thief runs past a young man with a bicycle on a street lined with trees and modern storefronts under bright daylight. (4) The pursuit continues along a park path with high-rise buildings in the background. Peeta is seen sprinting at high speed, now wearing sunglasses. The thief looks back with an exaggerated, comedic facial expression while clutching the money. (5) Peeta is shown jumping over a low metal railing in a park area with green grass and stone walkways. The editing pace is fast, showing rapid cuts of the two men running through different park locations. (6) The thief is then seen at a waterfront location, wearing a patterned shirt and sunglasses, holding the money and a glass of yellow juice, looking triumphant and manic. (7) The video concludes with a black information card displaying white and yellow text, brand logos, and event dates for a cruise party.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a clear male voice introducing the video with an energetic and friendly tone over a light rhythmic synthesizer bed. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs, followed by a sudden high-intensity shout '小偷啊!' which triggers a rapid sequence of footsteps and heavy breathing. (3) High-tempo, percussive electronic music kicks in with a strong bass beat. Repeated shouts of '不要跑' occur in a fast-paced, strained vocal delivery indicating physical exertion. (4) A low-frequency percussive 'thud' sound effect marks a visual jump over a railing, while the background noise shifts slightly toward open outdoor air. (5) A different male voice with a high-pitched, excited, and slightly manic tone yells about the money being on a boat, accompanied by the energetic music swelling in volume. (6) The music maintains its intensity as a final promotional voiceover provides event details, delivered with professional clarity and high energy before ending on a final musical beat.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, high-energy chase skit featuring a popular influencer to capture attention and build excitement for the 'STEPC Wave Party' cruise event. The transition from a gym theft to a waterfront celebration serves as a creative link to the event's theme.
